_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Flat leg with momentum/funding pinned near 50 and defensive extremes canceling mild greed keeps the coil intact; HOLD is the base-rate call until a breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst wrongly jumped to Complacency HOLD; narrative gave no phase path; consensus anchors Hope ±0 per score-band rule
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, 30d momentum near 50, funding flat, score holds inside Hope (63-70)
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum and funding expand together into Optimism, or spot breaks with a fear spike into Disbelief
